messages.author: afabdb12651bef78
messages.subject: SMC in a state-space model
parts:
Hi all,

I have a state-space model for  modeling the dynamics of a fish population.
The model is huge with many parameters and subprocesses.
The vector of the latent states has length 10 over 6 years, representing the population in numbers, which is divided in 10 length-categories over 6 years.
N[t,i];
t= 1,...,6
i= 1,...,10

My question is when we use the function
buildBootstrapFilter(exampleModel, nodes ="N" ,control = list(saveAll = TRUE, thresh = 0.9))

can we access the posterior distributions of the remaining subprocessess and parameters? Or do I need to include them in the nodes argument?


Thanks
Rui

messages.author: afabdb12651bef78
messages.subject: Re: SMC in a state-space model
parts:
Hi all,

after reading the paper
https://www.jstatsoft.org/article/download/v100i03/4210

I realized that it is not possible.
It says that: the particles returned from the algorithm will be samples from the smoothing distribution p(x1:T | y1:T ).

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: SMC in a state-space model
parts:
Hi Rui,

Thanks for posting the question and the follow-up.  Are the remaining subprocesses and parameters things that will be calculated between N[t, 1:10] and N[t+1, 1:10], or are they distinct from those?  Depending on what you're looking for, I could see it being somewhat straightforward or somewhat difficult.  But maybe you've already worked out the answer you need.

Best wishes,
Perry
